node: Transmission line hardware for AI/data-center grid buildout
summary: Expanded the transmission-line-hardware node into a compact two-lane universe. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is PLPC, a niche public supplier of hardware used in overhead energy and communications networks with reported backlog growth. HUBB is a larger reference/component leader with broad transmission connectors, insulators, arresters, and line-hardware exposure. VMI is an adjacent structures and utility infrastructure supplier that may benefit if transmission buildout shifts bottlenecks from EPC labor to fabricated support structures. MYRG is not a hardware supplier, but is included as a smaller EPC/customer-context anchor for validating whether transmission work is accelerating into the procurement layer. Claims linking these companies specifically to AI/data-center load growth remain mostly inference or hypothesis unless supported by future order, backlog, utility capex, or customer disclosures.
